ports.name: VENEZUELA — JOSÉ TERMINAL + MARACAIBO OIL INFRASTRUCTURE

details.WAS: PDVSA (Venezuela state) with Chinese "oil-for-debt" agreements giving China first claim on oil exports. China lent $60B+, repaid in oil. Venezuela was China's largest Western Hemisphere energy source.
details.NOW: Jan 3, 2026: Operation Absolute Resolve. Maduro captured. US DEA + military. Trump: "This is OUR Hemisphere." US claims it will "run Venezuela." Venezuelan government technically still in place. US access to oil reserves asserted.
details.EFFECT: Severs China's biggest Western Hemisphere energy lifeline. Cuts Russia's last Caribbean proxy. Cuba and Nicaragua signaled as next targets.

ports.alert: 🟡 China loses $60B+ in oil-for-debt agreements overnight. China is now the #2 user of the Panama Canal — after the US — and Venezuela was its hemispheric energy base. Both severed within 3 months in early 2026.

ports.location: Arctic — Greenland (Danish territory, strategic Arctic anchor)
ports.name: GREENLAND — NUUK PORT + ARCTIC ROUTES

details.OWNER: Kingdom of Denmark. Greenland Self-Government (Naalakkersuisut) has autonomy. No US ownership — yet.
details.WHY IT MATTERS: Controls the GIUK Gap (Greenland-Iceland-UK) — NATO's critical North Atlantic chokepoint. Arctic melting opens "Polar Silk Road" — China declared itself a "near-Arctic state." Greenland has rare earth minerals China currently monopolizes globally. US needs it to block both China's Arctic route and Russia's submarine access to the Atlantic.
details.STATUS: Trump demanded purchase/acquisition repeatedly. JD Vance visited Mar 2025. Denmark PM: "if US attacks a NATO member, everything stops." Trump ruled out military force for Canada — not explicitly for Greenland. Katie Miller: "soon." Greenland independence vote gaining momentum — possible pathway for US deal.
